acqua fiorentina — perfume 1 ml (.05 oz).name: Acqua Fiorentina — Perfume 1 ml (.05 oz) (Mini) para mujer
acqua fiorentina — perfume 1 ml (.05 oz).description: Inspired by the Italian Renaissance and the golden age of art and culture this is a fruity floral fragrance for women. Created by the venerable House of Creed, best known for designing perfumes for royalty, film stars and heads of state for seven generations, this is an ode to the modern renaissance woman, who has many interests. The top notes are plum and greengage, Renaissance roses, pink carnations, Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian lemon evoke the artistic heart of the fragrance, while in the base, cedar wood and sandalwood add a sophisticated finish.
